settings.question: How do I know which wiper blades fit my car?
settings.answer: Every Click Blades set is matched to your exact make, model and year. The fitment is shown right on this page, and our Perfect Fit Guarantee has you covered.

settings.question: Are Click Blades easy to install?
settings.answer: Yes. They clip on in under 2 minutes with no tools. Remove your old blades and clip the new ones into place.

settings.question: How long do Click Blades last?
settings.answer: With normal use, 12 to 18 months depending on conditions. Replace them if you notice streaking or skipping.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: 30-day satisfaction guarantee with a full refund, no questions asked. If they don't fit or you're not happy, email sales@clickshades.com.au.

settings.question: When will my order be dispatched?
settings.answer: Same-day despatch on orders placed before 2:00 PM (AWST), Monday to Friday. Orders after 2:00 PM or on weekends ship the next business day. Shipped from Bibra Lake, WA.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Free standard shipping on all wiper blade orders across Australia. Express is available at checkout for an extra $10.

settings.question: Do you sell rear wiper blades too?
settings.answer: Right now we focus on front windscreen wiper blades. Rear blades are coming soon.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Shop Pay and Afterpay.
